name: Kessel Annex
blurb: Interior Ministry records office, Kessel. Public kiosk in the lobby.
_note: Commands per node. 'trace' = trace meter %, 'time' = laptop minutes, 'set' = lab flags, 'learn' = verbs that become assist chips, 'reveal' = nodes that appear on the map. Story effects use 'do' (same actions as days.json).

scan.text:
Citizen Records Kiosk v1.2 (State Electronics Combine)
  Maintenance login: ENABLED
  Last updated: 2033
  Network: ANNEX-OFFICE

login.text:
Logged in as maintenance. The kiosk's menu is ugly and wide open.
From here you can see the office network.

scan.text:
ANNEX-OFFICE: 3 devices answer.
  printer       HearthPrint Office 600
  clerk-pc-3    Records desk 3
  camera-hub    Lobby + corridor cameras

HearthPrint Office 600, firmware 2.1 (2029)
  Stores the last 200 scanned pages in memory.
  Memory is readable without a login. (Of course it is.)

pull.text:
Pulling scanned pages... most are canteen menus and leave forms.
Three pages are from an intake ledger.

scan.text:
Records desk 3, HEARTH OS 7.1
  User: m.duda (Records, part-time)
  Password hint (set by user): "my class"
  Mapped drive: ARCHIVE-SRV
  Lockout after 3 wrong passwords.

login.text:
Logged in as m.duda.
Desktop wallpaper: a class photo. Thirty nine-year-olds and a smiling teacher.
You know one of the children. She's in the second row.
login.lock_text: ACCOUNT LOCKED. IT will call m.duda in the morning to ask why someone tried her password three times.

scan.text:
Camera hub: 6 cameras (lobby, corridor, archive door)
  admin password changed in 2035 (someone did their job once)
  Playback 'loop' function: no login required.

login.fail_text: Access denied. Someone changed this one.

loop.text:
Cameras now replay yesterday's footage for the next 10 minutes.
If anyone were standing in that corridor tonight, nobody would see them.

scan.text:
Interior Ministry archive, Kessel Annex
  Facility 4 intake ledger (current)
  Reachable from clerk-pc-3

wipe.text: Kiosk access log trimmed. Tonight never happened. (On this machine.)

hints.text: Start with what you can reach: scan kiosk
Eight years without updates. Anything still on factory settings? The kiosk manual is on NetState. Try: login kiosk maintenance
You're on the kiosk. What else is on its network? Try: scan network
Three devices. The archive drive hangs off a clerk's PC. Try: scan clerk-pc-3
The password hint is 'my class'. A teacher working part-time at the Annex... where have you seen the name Duda? (Lena's homework, in Files.) Login: login clerk-pc-3 m.duda
You're in her account. Open the mapped drive: open archive-srv
Pull the whole ledger (loud, +30% trace) or leave quietly. Wipe your tracks on the way out (wipe logs), then logout.

burn.why: your connection to the Annex kiosk was traced (they patched it the next morning)

lead.why: the Annex kiosk logged a maintenance login at night (you didn't wipe the logs)
